_note: 历史人物候选池。画像是「最像你的一位历史人物」的备选来源。要加人：把 webp 放进 portraits/，再在这里加一条。traits_* 是给模型比对用的性情条目，blurb_* 是界面上显示的一句话。

figures.blurb_zh: 教了一辈子书的老师，把「怎么做人」当成一门可以学的学问。
figures.blurb_en: A teacher all his life, who treated how to live as something that can be learned.
figures.traits_zh: 好学不倦，三人行必有我师；重视礼与日常规矩；有教无类，愿意花时间带人；一生奔走推行理想，明知做不到也去做；关心家人与朋友的相处之道
figures.traits_en: Learns endlessly, finds a teacher in everyone; values ritual and everyday order; teaches anyone willing, gives people his time; travels for years pushing an ideal he knows he cannot complete; cares about how family and friends treat one another
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Confucius at Leisure

figures.blurb_zh: 主张「少折腾」的智者，看得比当下远。
figures.blurb_en: The sage who argued for doing less, and saw further than the moment.
figures.traits_zh: 相信柔弱胜过刚强，不与人争；话少，讨厌繁文缛节；凡事想退一步看长远；看穿名利的代价；宁静自处，不急着证明自己
figures.traits_en: Believes yielding outlasts force, does not compete; speaks little, dislikes fuss and ceremony; steps back to see the long view; sees what fame and gain cost; quiet, in no hurry to prove himself
figures.credit_en: Zhang Lu, Laozi Riding an Ox

figures.blurb_zh: 把功名看得很淡的怪才，想象天马行空。
figures.blurb_en: An eccentric who cared nothing for office, with an imagination that wandered freely.
figures.traits_zh: 蔑视权贵与功名；爱用寓言和荒诞的比喻讲道理；看重精神的自由；对生死看得开；不喜欢被规矩捆住
figures.traits_en: Scorns power and rank; explains things through fables and absurd parables; prizes inner freedom above all; untroubled by thoughts of death; refuses to be tied down by rules
figures.credit_en: Zhuangzi, from the Ten Daoist Masters album

figures.blurb_zh: 说话最不留情面的儒者，认死理也讲义气。
figures.blurb_en: The bluntest of the Confucians: stubborn about principle, loyal to his friends.
figures.traits_zh: 相信人性本善，讲浩然之气；论辩激烈，不肯让步；关心普通人的生计；有强烈的正义感；认准的道义绝不妥协
figures.traits_en: Holds that people are born good, speaks of a vast moral courage; argues hard, never concedes; cares about how ordinary people make a living; has a sharp sense of justice; never compromises on what he believes right
figures.credit_zh: 元《至圣先贤半身像·孟轲》
figures.credit_en: Meng Ke, from the Yuan album Half Portraits of the Sages

figures.blurb_zh: 宁折不弯的诗人，把理想和失望都写进了诗里。
figures.blurb_en: A poet who would rather break than bend, who wrote his ideals and his grief into verse.
figures.traits_zh: 理想主义，不肯同流合污；对故国与所托之人忠贞；情绪浓烈，善用香草美人寄托心意；宁可自沉也不肯低头；孤独而清高
figures.traits_en: Idealistic, refuses to go along with the crowd; utterly loyal to his country and the one he served; intense feeling, expresses himself through imagery and symbolism; would rather drown than bow; solitary and proud
figures.credit_en: Chen Hongshou, Qu Yuan Walking and Singing

figures.blurb_zh: 忍辱写成史书的史官，把话留给后世。
figures.blurb_en: The historian who endured humiliation to finish his book, leaving his case to posterity.
figures.traits_zh: 忍辱负重，为完成一件事能咽下极大的委屈；考据严谨，重证据；看人看得透，不轻易下褒贬；以著述自任；对失败者与边缘人多同情
figures.traits_en: Endures humiliation to finish the work; rigorous, insists on evidence; sees people clearly without rushing to praise or blame; treats writing as his life's charge; sympathises with the failed and the overlooked
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Sima Qian

figures.blurb_zh: 一生谨慎、事必躬亲的谋士。
figures.blurb_en: The strategist who was careful to a fault and handled everything himself.
figures.traits_zh: 做事谨慎，反复推演；凡事亲自过问，不容易放手；对托付的事负责到底；善于规划与统筹；清廉自守，不谋私利
figures.traits_en: Careful, runs the scenarios again and again; checks everything himself and finds it hard to delegate; sees a trust through to the end; good at planning and coordinating many moving parts; incorruptible, seeks nothing for himself
figures.credit_en: Zhang Feng, Portrait of Zhuge Liang

figures.blurb_zh: 辞官归田的诗人，清贫自守。
figures.blurb_en: The poet who resigned office to farm and kept his integrity on very little.
figures.traits_zh: 不慕荣利，宁可清贫也不受拘束；爱酒、爱菊、爱读书；把日常琐事过成诗；做决定先问是否违背本心；喜欢安静独处与自然
figures.traits_en: Indifferent to rank and gain, prefers poverty to being constrained; loves wine, chrysanthemums and books; turns ordinary days into poetry; asks first whether a choice betrays his own heart; enjoys quiet solitude and the outdoors
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Tao Yuanming

figures.blurb_zh: 四海漫游的诗人，酒、剑与月亮。
figures.blurb_en: The wandering poet of wine, swords and moonlight.
figures.traits_zh: 豪放不羁，情绪外放；爱酒、爱月、爱山水；四处漫游，不愿久居一地；自信甚至自负，不惯受拘束；重朋友义气，交游极广
figures.traits_en: Uninhibited and expressive; loves wine, moonlight and mountains; roams from place to place, unwilling to settle; confident to the point of arrogance, cannot stand restriction; loyal to friends, knows everyone
figures.credit_en: Liang Kai, Li Bai Walking and Singing

figures.blurb_zh: 把眼睛里看到的苦都写下来的诗人。
figures.blurb_en: The poet who wrote down every hardship he saw.
figures.traits_zh: 沉郁内敛，情感厚重；细致体察身边人的处境；关心弱者与家国；写实，不粉饰；一生漂泊困顿，仍坚持写诗
figures.traits_en: Reserved and heavy-hearted; notices the situation of the people around him in detail; cares about the weak and about his country; writes plainly without embellishment; drifted and struggled all his life yet never stopped writing
figures.credit_en: Portrait of Du Fu, former Qing palace collection

figures.blurb_zh: 一贬再贬，仍然吃得下睡得着的全才。
figures.blurb_en: Exiled again and again, and still able to eat well and sleep soundly.
figures.traits_zh: 旷达幽默，逆境中也能自得其乐；诗文书画样样精通；爱美食、爱交朋友；既通政务也懂生活；被人排挤也不记恨
figures.traits_en: Broad-minded and funny, finds pleasure even in exile; accomplished in poetry, prose, calligraphy and painting; loves good food and good company; competent in office and in life; bears no grudge against those who pushed him out
figures.credit_en: Zhao Mengfu, Portrait of Su Shi

figures.blurb_zh: 讲「知行合一」的读书人，也是能带兵的人。
figures.blurb_en: A scholar who taught that knowing and doing are one, and who could also lead troops.
figures.traits_zh: 强调知与行必须合一，反对空谈；遇事不慌，越危难越镇定；在具体事情上磨练心性；善于开导别人，爱讲学；既有学问也能办实事
figures.traits_en: Insists that knowing and doing must be one, distrusts talk without action; stays calm in a crisis, steadier the worse it gets; tempers his character through concrete work; good at talking people round, loves to teach; scholarly and practical at once
figures.credit_en: Cai Shixin, Portrait of Wang Yangming

figures.blurb_zh: 续写《汉书》的女学者。
figures.blurb_en: The woman scholar who completed the Book of Han.
figures.traits_zh: 学问扎实，肯做冗长的案头工作；性情沉稳端庄；以整理与传授知识为己任；重视规矩与家教；谨慎持重，不轻易表态
figures.traits_en: Solidly learned, willing to do years of tedious desk work; steady and dignified; takes it as her duty to organise and pass on knowledge; values order and family teaching; cautious, does not speak out rashly
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Ban Zhao

figures.blurb_zh: 通音律、历尽颠沛的女诗人。
figures.blurb_en: A poet and musician who lived through capture and displacement.
figures.traits_zh: 才情过人，精通音律与诗文；经历坎坷而情感深沉；记性极好，能凭记忆默写典籍；内心敏感，善于把痛苦写进作品；坚韧，能熬过去
figures.traits_en: Exceptionally gifted in music and poetry; deep feeling shaped by a hard life; prodigious memory, could write out lost texts from recall; sensitive, turns suffering into work; tough enough to survive it
figures.credit_en: Cai Wenji, from the album Gathering Gems of Beauty

figures.blurb_zh: 词写得好，日子也过得讲究。
figures.blurb_en: A master of the ci form who was particular about how she lived, too.
figures.traits_zh: 感受细腻，善于写细节与心情；精通诗词与金石书画；生活讲究，爱收藏；心气高，不肯将就；晚年流离，笔力不减
figures.traits_en: Finely sensitive, writes detail and mood with precision; expert in poetry and in antiquities; particular about daily life and fond of collecting; proud, refuses to settle for less; kept her power as a writer through years of displacement
figures.credit_en: Qing-dynasty copy, Portrait of Li Qingzhao

figures.blurb_zh: 敢连夜私奔，也敢当垆卖酒。
figures.blurb_en: She eloped by night, and she was not too proud to pour wine for customers.
figures.traits_zh: 有主见，认定了就敢违背家庭与世俗；懂得经营生计，能放下身段；才情与胆气兼具；感情里要求平等与尊重；果断，不拖泥带水
figures.traits_en: Self-willed, will defy family and convention once decided; good at making a living and unafraid of menial work; gifted and bold at once; demands equality and respect in love; decisive, never dithers
figures.credit_en: Zhuo Wenjun, from the album Gathering Gems of Beauty

figures.blurb_zh: 抛家别子去革命的女性。
figures.blurb_en: She left her family behind to join a revolution.
figures.traits_zh: 刚烈果敢，认准的事不顾一切；强烈关注妇女的处境；爱穿男装、习武、饮酒，不拘小节；忧国，宁可牺牲自己；行动先于顾虑
figures.traits_en: Fierce and resolute, stops at nothing once decided; deeply concerned with the position of women; wore men's clothes, practised martial arts, drank, ignored niceties; anxious for her country, willing to die for it; acts before she worries
figures.credit_en: Photograph, between 1900 and 1907

figures.blurb_zh: 替父从军的女子，回来还是原来的样子。
figures.blurb_en: She took her father's place in the army and came home unchanged.
figures.traits_zh: 孝顺，替家人扛下最难的事；勇敢能吃苦，在陌生环境里也不露怯；不慕功名，事成之后只求回家；务实，手脚麻利；低调，不夸耀自己
figures.traits_en: Dutiful, takes on the hardest task for her family; brave and hardy, shows no fear in unfamiliar company; wants no honours, asks only to go home when it is done; practical and quick-handed; modest, never boasts
figures.credit_en: Mulan, from the album Gathering Gems of Beauty

figures.blurb_zh: 以剑舞名动天下的艺人。
figures.blurb_en: The performer whose sword dance was famous across the empire.
figures.traits_zh: 技艺精湛，把一门手艺练到极致；气场强，一上台就压得住全场；性情爽朗，不藏着掖着；凭本事立身，不靠门第；把力气与美合在一起
figures.traits_en: A performer who drove one skill to its limit; commanding presence, holds a crowd the moment she appears; open and forthright, hides nothing; lives by her own ability, not by family name; joins force and grace in one art
figures.credit_en: Lady Gongsun, from the album Gathering Gems of Beauty

figures.blurb_zh: 一眼看出谁是英雄，连夜跟他走。
figures.blurb_en: She recognised a hero at a glance and left with him that night.
figures.traits_zh: 眼光极准，看人看事一针见血；果断，决定了立刻行动；不肯屈居人下，主动选择自己的命运；有侠气，重义气；头脑清楚，善于判断局势
figures.traits_en: A sharp judge of people, cuts to the truth at once; decisive, acts the moment she decides; refuses to be anyone's subordinate and chooses her own fate; has a chivalrous streak and values loyalty; clear-headed about who holds the advantage
figures.credit_en: Hongfu, from the album Gathering Gems of Beauty

figures.blurb_zh: 王羲之的老师，把书法讲成法度的人。
figures.blurb_en: Wang Xizhi's teacher, who turned calligraphy into a teachable discipline.
figures.traits_zh: 专业上极为严谨，讲究法度与传承；耐心教人，善于把自己的经验讲清楚；温婉而有见识；重师承，也重根基；一生专注一件事
figures.traits_en: Rigorous in her craft, attentive to method and lineage; patient as a teacher, good at making her experience explicit; gentle but perceptive; values both tradition and solid foundations; spends a lifetime on one thing
figures.credit_zh: 王翙《百美新咏图传·卫夫人》
figures.credit_en: Wang Hui, Lady Wei, from the Hundred Beauties album

figures.blurb_zh: 在街上不停发问的老人。
figures.blurb_en: The old man who would not stop asking questions in the street.
figures.traits_zh: 爱追问，靠一连串问题把对方的想当然问倒；承认自己无知，却不肯停止思考；不惧权威与多数人的意见；生活简朴，不在乎物质；重视德性与自我省察
figures.traits_en: Relentless questioner, dismantles other people's assumptions one question at a time; admits his own ignorance yet will not stop thinking; unafraid of authority or majority opinion; lives simply and cares nothing for possessions; puts virtue and self-examination first
figures.credit_zh: 罗马摹本大理石像（据留西波斯）
figures.credit_en: Roman marble copy after Lysippos

figures.blurb_zh: 手握大权却每天反省自己的皇帝。
figures.blurb_en: An emperor with absolute power who examined himself daily.
figures.traits_zh: 高度自省，每天检视自己的念头；克制情绪，不轻易发怒；把责任看得比享乐重；接受命运，专注自己能控制的部分；勤勉，长期承担繁重的事务
figures.traits_en: Deeply self-examining, reviews his own thoughts daily; restrains his temper and seldom gets angry; puts duty above pleasure; accepts what fate sends and works on what he can control; industrious, carries heavy responsibility for years
figures.credit_zh: 慕尼黑古代雕塑展览馆藏胸像
figures.credit_en: Bust in the Glyptothek, Munich

figures.blurb_zh: 写书信劝人平静的斯多葛派。
figures.blurb_en: The Stoic who wrote letters teaching others to stay calm.
figures.traits_zh: 善用文字开导别人，理性而温和；看重内心的平静，不被外物牵动；对时间极度珍惜；承认自己也有弱点，不装圣人；关注如何在忙乱中保持清醒
figures.traits_en: Counsels others through writing, rational and gentle; prizes inner calm, unmoved by circumstance; guards his time jealously; admits his own weaknesses and plays no saint; preoccupied with staying clear-headed amid chaos
figures.credit_zh: 荷兰国立博物馆藏版画肖像（1776）
figures.credit_en: Engraved portrait, Rijksmuseum, 1776

figures.blurb_zh: 把自己当成研究对象写随笔的人。
figures.blurb_en: The essayist who made himself his own subject.
figures.traits_zh: 内省，喜欢观察自己的念头；怀疑主义，不相信绝对真理；博览群书，随手引证；写得坦率，连自己的缺点也写；远离争斗，退居书斋
figures.traits_en: Introspective, watches his own thinking; a sceptic who distrusts absolute truths; widely read, quotes at will; writes candidly, flaws included; keeps clear of conflict, retreats to his study
figures.credit_zh: 佚名《蒙田像》（16 世纪 70 年代）
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Montaigne, 1570s

figures.blurb_zh: 靠磨镜片为生、拒绝教职的哲学家。
figures.blurb_en: The philosopher who ground lenses for a living and turned down a professorship.
figures.traits_zh: 甘于清贫，为了思想自由宁愿过简朴生活；理性，凡事讲求推演与秩序；不与人争辩，也不拉帮结派；专注，能长时间独自思考；温和有礼，与人为善
figures.traits_en: Accepts poverty, choosing a plain life to keep his thinking free; rational, works everything out in order; does not argue or join factions; focused, capable of long solitary thought; gentle and courteous to everyone
figures.credit_en: Anonymous, Portrait of Spinoza, 1665

figures.blurb_zh: 一生没离开过小城，作息准得像钟表。
figures.blurb_en: He never left his small city, and his daily round ran like a clock.
figures.traits_zh: 极其自律，生活作息几十年不变；乐于独处，社交有限但重友谊；讲求条理与规则；关心普遍的道德原则；终身学习，晚年仍在写新东西
figures.traits_en: Extremely disciplined, kept the same daily routine for decades; happy alone, has few but valued friendships; wants order and rules; concerned with universal moral principles; a lifelong learner still writing new work in old age
figures.credit_zh: 约翰·戈特利布·贝克尔《康德像》（1768）
figures.credit_en: Johann Gottlieb Becker, Portrait of Kant, 1768

figures.blurb_zh: 提出「重估一切价值」的孤独思想家。
figures.blurb_en: The lonely thinker who demanded a revaluation of all values.
figures.traits_zh: 思想激烈，惯于质疑流行观念；孤独，长期不被人理解；身体不好仍坚持写作；崇尚生命力与自我超越；文风锋利，不留情面
figures.traits_en: Fierce in thought, instinctively challenges whatever is fashionable; lonely, long misunderstood; keeps writing through chronic illness; prizes vitality and self-overcoming; writes with a sharp, unforgiving edge
figures.credit_zh: 弗里德里希·赫尔曼·哈特曼摄（约 1875）
figures.credit_en: Photograph by Friedrich Hermann Hartmann, c. 1875

figures.blurb_zh: 在湖边自己盖房子住了两年的人。
figures.blurb_en: He built a cabin by a pond and lived there for two years.
figures.traits_zh: 喜欢简朴生活，反感多余的消费；爱自然，长时间独自散步与观察；主动远离社会竞争；记录细致，天天写日记；有主张，反对不义之事
figures.traits_en: Prefers a simple life and dislikes needless consumption; loves nature, takes long solitary walks and observes closely; steps away from social competition on purpose; records everything in a daily journal; has principles and speaks against injustice
figures.credit_zh: 本杰明·马克斯汉姆摄银版照片（1856）
figures.credit_en: Daguerreotype by Benjamin D. Maxham, 1856

figures.blurb_zh: 用二十年耐心写成一本书的人。
figures.blurb_en: He spent twenty years patiently finishing a single book.
figures.traits_zh: 极度耐心，长期积累零碎的观察；细致到近乎笨拙地记录事实；谨慎，不轻易下结论；身体欠佳仍按部就班工作；对自然现象有持久的好奇
figures.traits_en: Endlessly patient, accumulates small observations over decades; records facts with painstaking care; cautious, refuses to conclude too soon; keeps a steady routine despite poor health; lastingly curious about how nature works
figures.credit_en: Photograph by Henry Maull and John Fox, c. 1854

figures.blurb_zh: 出身寒微、把国家扛在肩上的总统。
figures.blurb_en: A president from a poor background who carried a country on his shoulders.
figures.traits_zh: 沉稳克制，情绪很少外露；善于讲故事化解僵局；体恤弱者，反对不公；承担责任，不推给别人；坚忍，在最糟的时候也不放弃
figures.traits_en: Steady and restrained, rarely shows feeling; uses stories to break a deadlock; sympathises with the weak and opposes injustice; takes responsibility rather than passing it on; endures, and does not quit at the worst moment
figures.credit_en: Photograph by Alexander Gardner, 1863

figures.blurb_zh: 一生困顿、画到最后一刻的人。
figures.blurb_en: He was poor and misunderstood, and painted until the end.
figures.traits_zh: 情感炽烈，投入起来不计代价；对色彩与光线极度敏感；长期贫困与孤独，仍不停地画；不善与人相处，却真心想靠近人；执着到近乎固执
figures.traits_en: Intensely emotional, gives everything once committed; acutely sensitive to colour and light; keeps painting through poverty and loneliness; awkward with people yet genuinely wants closeness; persistent to the point of stubbornness
figures.credit_en: Vincent van Gogh, Self-Portrait, 1887

figures.blurb_zh: 什么都想弄明白的好奇心怪物。
figures.blurb_en: A man who wanted to understand absolutely everything.
figures.traits_zh: 好奇心没有边界，艺术、机械、解剖都要研究；观察细致，反复画速写；追求完美，常常拖到交不出活；独立思考，不轻信权威；安静，不爱张扬
figures.traits_en: Boundless curiosity — art, machinery and anatomy alike; observes in detail and sketches the same thing again and again; a perfectionist who often fails to deliver; thinks for himself and distrusts authority; quiet, never self-promoting
figures.credit_zh: 弗朗切斯科·梅尔齐《达·芬奇像》（约 1515）
figures.credit_en: Attributed to Francesco Melzi, Portrait of Leonardo, c. 1515

figures.blurb_zh: 一生不嫁，把国家当成婚姻的女王。
figures.blurb_en: She never married, and spoke of her country as her husband.
figures.traits_zh: 政治上的谨慎与耐心，从不轻易表态；善于用人又处处防范；终身学习，通晓多门语言；克制个人情感服从职责；形象意识强，懂得怎么让人信服
figures.traits_en: Politically cautious and patient, never shows her hand early; a good judge of people and wary of all of them; learned all her life, fluent in several languages; subordinates personal feeling to duty; keenly aware of image and how to command belief
figures.credit_en: Unidentified painter, the Darnley Portrait, 1575

figures.blurb_zh: 十几岁带兵解围的农家少女。
figures.blurb_en: A peasant girl in her teens who led an army to break a siege.
figures.traits_zh: 信念极其坚定，认定的事绝不回头；勇敢，年纪轻轻就敢带兵上阵；质朴直接，不懂也不屑权谋；行动力强，说做就做；甘愿牺牲，不求回报
figures.traits_en: Utterly convinced and never turns back; brave enough to lead troops while still very young; plain and direct, neither knowing nor wanting court intrigue; acts at once when action is needed; accepts sacrifice without asking for reward
figures.credit_zh: 中世纪抄本首字母细密画
figures.credit_en: Miniature in a historiated initial, medieval manuscript

figures.blurb_zh: 在客厅里看透人心的小说家。
figures.blurb_en: The novelist who saw through everyone from her own drawing room.
figures.traits_zh: 观察细腻，尤其擅长看穿人的虚荣与算计；讽刺含蓄，不用尖刻的词；活动圈子小，但在小圈子里看得极深；安静写作，不爱出风头；重视婚姻里的实际与尊重
figures.traits_en: A close observer, especially of vanity and calculation; ironic without ever being harsh; moves in a small circle but sees deeply within it; writes quietly and avoids the limelight; values practicality and respect in marriage
figures.credit_zh: 卡桑德拉·奥斯汀《简·奥斯汀像》（约 1810）
figures.credit_en: Cassandra Austen, Portrait of Jane Austen, c. 1810

figures.blurb_zh: 学识极好的小说家，敢于不合世俗。
figures.blurb_en: A formidable scholar of a novelist who refused to live by convention.
figures.traits_zh: 博学，兼通哲学与科学；理性而富有同情心；敢于违背世俗选择自己的生活；写作厚重，关心普通人的命运；思想独立，不依附他人
figures.traits_en: Deeply learned in philosophy and science alike; rational and compassionate; willing to defy convention in how she lives; writes with weight and cares about ordinary lives; independent in thought and dependent on no one
figures.credit_zh: 弗朗索瓦·达尔贝·迪拉德的摹本（19 世纪）
figures.credit_en: Replica by François D'Abert Durade, 19th century

figures.blurb_zh: 几乎不出门，却写了一千多首诗。
figures.blurb_en: She barely left the house, and wrote well over a thousand poems.
figures.traits_zh: 极度内向，主动减少社交；观察细微，从日常小事里看出大问题；思想独立，不信教条；用写作处理内心的情绪；生活简朴克制
figures.traits_en: Deeply introverted, deliberately limits social contact; notices tiny things and finds large questions in them; independent-minded, accepts no dogma; uses writing to work through feeling; lives plainly and with restraint
figures.credit_en: Anonymous daguerreotype, c. 1847

figures.blurb_zh: 最早系统为女性争取教育权的人。
figures.blurb_en: The first to argue systematically that women deserve an education.
figures.traits_zh: 主张女性应当受教育、能独立；敢于公开论战，不怕被攻击；情感强烈，行事不合常规；靠写作为生，自食其力；关心人的理性与尊严
figures.traits_en: Argues that women must be educated and able to stand alone; takes on public argument and does not fear attack; strong-feeling and unconventional in her conduct; earns her own living by writing; cares about human reason and dignity
figures.credit_zh: 约翰·奥皮《玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特像》（1797）
figures.credit_en: John Opie, Portrait of Mary Wollstonecraft, 1797

figures.blurb_zh: 把护理变成一门科学的护士。
figures.blurb_en: The nurse who turned care into a science.
figures.traits_zh: 有强烈的使命感；务实，凡事用数据说话；管理能力强，善于组织人手；长期带病工作，极其勤勉；不满足于做好事，要求把事情做对
figures.traits_en: Driven by a strong sense of purpose; practical, argues from data; an able administrator who organises people well; works on despite chronic illness; not satisfied with good intentions, insists on doing the thing right
figures.credit_en: Photograph by Henry Hering, c. 1860

figures.blurb_zh: 第一个看出机器能做什么的人。
figures.blurb_en: The first to see what a machine could really be used for.
figures.traits_zh: 想象力与数学能力兼具；能从一个装置里看出别人看不到的可能性；写作清晰，善于解释复杂的事；性情热切，爱钻研；靠严格训练克服散漫
figures.traits_en: Imaginative and mathematical at once; sees possibilities in a device that others miss; writes clearly and explains complex things well; eager by temperament and loves to dig in; uses strict discipline to master a scattered streak
figures.credit_zh: 安托万·克劳德摄银版照片（约 1843）
figures.credit_en: Daguerreotype by Antoine Claudet, c. 1843
